system.description:
A zealous individual who thinks nothing of going to extremes. Some of them even inflict crippling injuries upon themselves, or truss their limbs up in chains or cages in order to demonstrate their devotion. It takes huge resilience to survive for any length of time as a flagellant, and the prophets of doom are a hardy folk. They only have prevailed against the beasts and enemies they have encountered during their wanderings, but they have also suffered the tortures and austeritys they have inflicted upon themselves in the process.

A character must have come to the gloomy interpretation of sacred texts, and they become practiced in their ranting loudly and at length about their apocalyptic convictions. Amongst these veteran flagellants it is customary to show their devotion to the gods by voluntarily undergoing all the manner of hardship. Flagellants are named after their habit of scourging themselves, but they by even more often employ even more with extreme self mortification.
